context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach Self Journey as parent1: go to /login first, click 'Sign in with email' link, fill login-email-input + login-password-input + login-submit-button; then localStorage.setItem('sacoparents_last_door','self'); goto('/'); accept legal; back out of any sub-view until door-self-progress-ring is visible. To reach Court path: localStorage sacoparents_last_door='court' + legal + fill court-key dialog with ALIGN-SA-2026. The SA page is a fixed inset-0 z-50 overlay — clicking other page buttons behind it will fail; use the overlay's own Close button to dismiss. PDF text asserts should use pypdf (NOT raw latin-1 decode) because the PDF streams are FlateDecode-compressed. pp-summary-court-notes-pdf is only rendered inside the PP page's plan-summary panel after the plan is marked completed — not reachable without first filling the full 6-step plan; relying on code inspection + the pp-court-notes-pdf (checklist) button + backend route verification was sufficient.
